assurance: Editing assistance for the identified plugin catalog, context and configurations only. Not plugin trust, runtime availability, profile validation or deployment approval.

functions.bound: total input and output at most maxFunctionInputBytes
output (two characters per byte) at most maxFunctionInputBytes
one-level canonical scalar map; missing field or invalid CBOR rejects the cascade

expressionOperators.operands: boolean, T, T (only the selected branch is evaluated)
text, text-set fact (admission rules only; stops at the first match)
text, text or bytes, bytes (a text prefix is a UTF-8 byte prefix)
boolean body per write-view element, in index order; false at the first false (admission rules only; no nesting)
boolean body per write-view element, in index order; true at the first true (admission rules only; no nesting)

scopes.name: event
scopes.note: fields of the event a binding subscribes to

scopes.name: command
scopes.note: DATA fields of the selected command; only in a rule that names a command

scopes.name: context
scopes.note: in a binding, the step that produced the event; in a rule, the step being admitted

scopes.name: facts
scopes.note: facts the attached kernel declares and established by its own verification

scopes.name: reads
scopes.note: the rule's declared state reads: reads.<name>.present, reads.<name>.<field> and reads.<name>.value.<field>, decoded by the read component's kernel

scopes.name: writes
scopes.note: the current element w of writes.all(w, ...) or writes.exists(w, ...): content fields in either slot; coverage fields make the rule a fact rule

sourceForms.note: an event field; the only source an evidence field accepts
a DATA field of the selected command
a restricted CEL expression; as a condition, rule clause, lookup or read key, or mapping source

slots.name: admission
slots.when: after the kernel's admit hooks and before work reservation; rules that read neither facts nor write coverage

slots.name: fact
slots.when: after an approved kernel decision; rules that read facts or write coverage

rules.static: no reads, and expression clauses over command, params, config and write content only; also checked at ingress

baselineEvent.materialized: only when a binding subscribes to it

effects.note: effect types are free text; no effect payload schema is published by this catalog
